name: Rachel
source:
A quiet young girl, a year younger then the other gals. She feels lucky to be included with the other girls, and doesn't speak her mind often. As she grows up, she begins to change herself and work at what she considers to be her best qualities. As she begins to better herself, she begins to question her past self and if her friends are what they say they are.

[From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/anticipation-apprehension-adolescence-book-1]IndieDB[/url]]
